_README: P6 powered battery (PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_PREREG.md §8, H6). Every aggregate is DERIVED from the per-task rows below — the rows are the baseline (a list, never a count). Arms: main (full ladder) vs frozen (C-CODEBOOK-FROZEN: 8 starter shapes, no spine, bigrams absent). Primary score: accepted Program whose ProgEval agrees on ALL held-out rows. Wilson 95% CIs; delta CI is Newcombe hybrid score. Standing rule applied: deltas within ~3x the per-episode step are not results.

condition.batching: one FRESH substrate per task (ensure_program_synthesis boot), tasks in sorted-id order; no cross-task state
condition.pipeline: domains/prog_synthesis.synthesize_from_request (the unchanged P4 loop; seeds/program_synthesis.json rules decide)
scope_pins: languages: verdict layer is ProgEval on the hub IR (python-frame execution semantics); rust/lua/llvm-x86 are measured as RENDER+toolchain validity on the subsample, not as independent synthesis arms
task domain: integer / list-of-integer inputs, SCALAR outputs (ProgEval's value space; the row-verdict fact records `got` only for scalars)
recognition failures (no goal minted) count in the denominator and are reported separately

error_handling stratum measures spec-level fallback behaviour only — no rung can synthesize ProgTryOr; a division task passing via the DSL's div-by-zero->0.0 semantics is a documented coincidence, not a try/except capability

task_set.contamination_guard: checked at run time: no request text appears in tests/test_program_synthesis_migrated.py (the P4 gate fixtures — the mechanism's dev set) nor equals any frozen 26-item C-BATTERY request
